author: Bobby Grayson
description: git branch lists wf/crash wf/init wf/notes wf/receive wf/sysprops; git diff dacf642..<b> --stat for each shows NOTES.md only on wf/notes. git show dacf642:NOTES.md fails (file is new). README.md at dacf642 has no reference to NOTES.md, so the integrator may want one line in README pointing to NOTES.md; this is the only place wf/notes could touch a file another branch also touches, and none do. Merge of wf/notes is therefore conflict-free: it adds one file and does not touch elixir/to_lean.exs, so render_clauses / clauses / sends / plain_body conflicts are entirely among wf/crash, wf/init, wf/receive.
title: Builder warned a second NOTES.md branch might exist; chronicler confirmed only wf/notes adds NOTES.md, no NOTES.md at dacf642, README.md does not link it, and no other wf/* branch touches docs
